name: spin-sales-coach
description: SPIN-model sales coaching app — wraps the web app in a Capacitor Android shell.

scripts.copy-web: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www/icons && cp index.html styles.css app.js manifest.webmanifest service-worker.js www/ && cp icons/* www/icons/
scripts.prep: npm run copy-web && npx cap sync
scripts.android:add: npm run copy-web && npx cap add android
scripts.android:open: npm run prep && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run prep && npx cap run android
